auth.baseUrlRule: auth.baseUrl ?? getProvider('openai-codex').baseUrl ?? 'https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex', trailing slashes removed, append /codex once if absent
auth.headersRule: auth.headers preserved; chatgpt-account-id from the token claim; default originator pi and package User-Agent when absent; tool supplies a per-user-turn x-codex-image-turn-id without replacing a provided one
